limitations: Desktop Chromium and emulated mobile viewports/CDP touch input; no physical-phone performance measurement.
Manufacturing and later-stage VIP tests use funded/unlocked fixtures; results verify ledgers, stock conservation and circulation, not natural-player profit forecasts.

The 99-day run and some regression runs preceded final image, notification and layout refinements. Final production and 8-day VIP tests use the final two-cell display approach, consistent with previous saves. Economy rates/prices are unchanged.
